title: bucephalophora aculeata subsp. hispanica
intro: Bucephalophora aculeata subsp. hispanica, commonly known as Spanish thyme, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, making it a useful treatment for various health issues such as wounds, digestive problems, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Spanish thyme include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Spanish thyme include wound healing, digestive system support, and immune system modulation, highlighting its potential use in traditional medicine.
